title: Pain for All — The aura entry did not deal damage to my target (player).
scope: Pain for All ETB trigger ('enchanted creature deals damage equal to its power to any other target'): player-target leg + creature-target control leg; native engine, P0 + P1 human driver seats, protocol-98 driver
result: A1 setup passed; A2 aura attached to the 1/1 Memnite. A3 PASSED: the leg-1 ETB prompt advertised P1 (player, seat 1) as an available candidate among 7 (2 players + 5 creatures) - the triage's targeting hypothesis is disproven. A4 FAILED (the reported outcome): the trigger resolved with targets=[{Player: 1}] recorded on the stack entry, stack then empty, but P1 stayed at 20 life - zero damage. A5 control FAILED the same way: P1's Memnite was offered and chosen for leg 2, yet stayed on the battlefield with P1 at 20. Both target classes resolve to no damage, so the defect is in the DealDamage amount resolution - the parsed amount Ref(Power(Anaphoric 'enchanted creature')) - not in target legality. Zero rejections.
